issues.title: [Bug] "Run as goal" on a plan's Improve action arms an implement objective, so the agent starts executing the plan

en.headline: 7 commits across three repositories and one issue opened
en.summary: **7 commits** were recorded across three repositories, plus 5 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, 3 own commits split attribution correction data into SHA and identity fields, repaired missed personal commits using a SHA list, and refreshed local documentation for 10-23 after merging. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`, 2 own commits converted internal README documentation to clickable links and adjusted card heights, sans-serif headings, orange interactions, and example boxes. In `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`, 2 own commits required the user's global Git identity for commits and added Chrome built-in translation with split contributor documentation. The user opened or closed **1 issue**: `openchamber/openchamber` issue #5489, “[Bug] "Run as goal" on a plan's Improve action arms an implement objective, so the agent starts executing the plan”, which remains open with 1 comment. No pull requests, reviews, releases, or discussions were recorded.

zh.headline: 三个仓库共 7 次提交，并新开 1 个 issue
zh.summary: 当天在三个仓库记录了 **7 次提交**，另有 5 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的 3 次本人提交中，将归属修正数据拆分为 SHA 与身份两段，使用 SHA 名单修复漏计的本人提交，并在合并后按本地整份重取 10-23 数据并重渲染文档。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 的 2 次本人提交中，将 README 内部文档改为可点击链接，并调整卡片等高、无衬线标题、橙色交互与示例框。在 `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 的 2 次本人提交中，要求提交使用用户的全局 Git 身份，并新增 Chrome 内置翻译及拆分后的贡献者文档。用户新开或关闭了 **1 个 issue**：在 `openchamber/openchamber` 新开 issue #5489“[Bug] "Run as goal" on a plan's Improve action arms an implement objective, so the agent starts executing the plan”，该 issue 仍为开放状态，并有 1 条评论。当天没有 pull request、review、发布或讨论记录。
